reuse.why: Adds one assertBankAccountNotLinked helper reused by every provider, but does not hook it into the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount core that already receives syncSource and externalAccountId.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once; each of the five provider functions repeats a call with the provider string and account id that it also passes to linkBankSyncAccount.

placement.why: The check sits in each provider wrapper rather than in the shared link path (justified only by running before findOrCreateBank), so a new provider must remember to add it.

scope.why: Only the guard helper and its calls in the link functions.

maintainability.why: Clear single rule with a descriptive name and comment; the per-provider call is a small trap for future providers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five link functions still go through linkBankSyncAccount; the guard is added alongside it in each provider wrapper rather than inside it.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is copied; only five short calls to the new helper.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts is the single definition, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount (all link paths).
